artifacts.name: intent_validation.json
artifacts.decision: Report mechanical errors and non-blocking warnings without making semantic judgments.

artifacts.name: intent_fidelity.json
artifacts.decision: Report material semantic drift that structural checks cannot detect.

artifacts.name: intent_acceptance.json
artifacts.decision: Provide the single accepted, needs-clarification, or failed admission boundary.

artifacts.name: clarification.json
artifacts.decision: Stop on a material ambiguity or conflict and bind the user's answer.

artifacts.name: check_registry.json
artifacts.decision: Resolve every machine-checkable obligation to a known check and input artifact contract.

artifacts.name: requirement_ir.json
artifacts.decision: Compile workflow-independent obligations, scope, assumptions, approvals, and rollback semantics.

artifacts.name: requirement_format_evaluation.json
artifacts.decision: Fail closed on RequirementIR template, identity, source-reference, digest, or accepted-intent binding defects before downstream handoff.

artifacts.name: requirement_validation.json
artifacts.decision: Reject unresolved references, unregistered checks, invalid scope, or dishonest checkability.

artifacts.name: requirement_coverage.json
artifacts.decision: Reject any dropped IntentIR item before planning.

artifacts.name: strategy.json
artifacts.decision: Choose the smallest sufficient direct, reused, parameterized, extended, composed, generated, clarified, or rejected path.

artifacts.name: planning_catalog_snapshot.json
artifacts.decision: Freeze the workflows, capsules, physical operators, evaluators, and typed availability visible to planning and static binding.

artifacts.name: plan_ir.json
artifacts.decision: Define semantic logical nodes, dependencies, typed artifact ports, effects, and requirement ownership without mutable runtime state.

artifacts.name: plan_validation.json
artifacts.decision: Admit only a registered, acyclic, covered, gated, effect-safe plan.

artifacts.name: binding_trace.json
artifacts.decision: Map every obligation to owners, expected artifacts, and a registered verifier.

artifacts.name: run_contract.frozen.json
artifacts.decision: Make every runtime decision resolve against immutable content-hashed inputs.

artifacts.name: scheduler_input.json
artifacts.decision: Provide the one frozen executable graph the scheduler may act on, including dependencies, capsule bindings, ordered physical candidates, artifact handoffs, evaluator bindings, resource requirements, effects, priorities, and failure policies.

artifacts.name: task_graph_state.json
artifacts.decision: Record mutable run and node readiness without mutating PlanIR.

artifacts.name: dispatch_record.json
artifacts.decision: Record the chosen physical operator and why alternatives were skipped.

artifacts.name: lease_record.json
artifacts.decision: Fence node ownership and reject stale or duplicate results.

artifacts.name: approval_record.json
artifacts.decision: Authorize only the exact hashed irreversible or approval-bound effect.

artifacts.name: node_envelope.json
artifacts.decision: Carry typed status, error, output hashes, and attempt identity without log scraping.

artifacts.name: repair_record.json
artifacts.decision: Bind defects and exactly one permitted repair to a new artifact generation.

artifacts.name: gate_ledger.json
artifacts.decision: Require deterministic gate and independent evaluator agreement on the same generation.

artifacts.name: operator_state_log.json
artifacts.decision: Drive alternative selection from typed operator availability transitions.

artifacts.name: domain_evidence.json
artifacts.decision: Expose domain-owned evidence artifacts without embedding domain schemas in the control plane.

artifacts.name: artifact_manifest.json
artifacts.decision: Inventory declared outputs, content hashes, integrity, and missing artifacts across the run.

artifacts.name: evidence_ir.json
artifacts.decision: Provide the only mechanical path to GREEN by recomputing every obligation from retained artifacts.

artifacts.name: delivery_scope.json
artifacts.decision: Disclose assumptions, unverifiable obligations, and tested-versus-not-tested boundaries.

artifacts.name: final_delivery_manifest.json
artifacts.decision: Publish only independently green, content-hashed deliverables.

artifacts.name: experience_record.json
artifacts.decision: Retain outcomes, cost, and failures as examples rather than routing authority.

artifacts.name: promotion_record.json
artifacts.decision: Keep experience memory from entering the registry without independent green evidence.

artifacts.name: compilation_trace.json
artifacts.decision: Bind the complete artifact chain, stage outcomes, and immutable file hashes.
